::: {#rem-kraft-source}
#### Where Kraft's inequality comes from

@cover2006elements [section 5.2] prove @thm-kraft-inequality and @thm-kraft-converse.
They show in section 5.5 that the lengths of every [uniquely decodable code](source-coding.qmd#def-uniquely-decodable) have the same sum at most $1$,
so restricting to [prefix codes](#def-prefix-code) costs nothing in [expected length](source-coding.qmd#def-expected-length).
@mackay2003information [section 5.2] states the result for prefix codes as well.

:::
